review.summary: Round 2 reviews the whole TASK-076 range including the commit that addresses round 1 finding F-001. Outside the excluded review records, that commit changes one line of the testing document: the targeted Frontend Structure UI test command gains a filter that matches the new timeseries client test and no other file, so the command now runs seven files instead of six, and the six existing filters still match the same files. The implementation is unchanged since round 1, so its assessment stands. No regression or new finding. The documented Structure command, the frontend format check and the record validator pass; the broader frontend and backend checks were not repeated because no code changed, and passed in round 1.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: The targeted Frontend Structure UI test command in the testing document now includes a filter for the new timeseries client test; listing the matched files shows it is run alongside the six earlier files, and the command passes.
